top_signals.title: Latest Oil Market News and Analysis for Aug. 19
top_signals.summary: Oil held a four-day run of gains as traders assessed the standoff in the Middle East between Iran and the US, with signs some crude is being shipped through the Strait of Hormuz to global markets.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Rogue ransomware affiliate poses as recovery firm to steal payments
top_signals.summary: A suspected ransomware affiliate is posing as a ransomware recovery service called "Ransom Busters," contacting the victims before the attacks become public and claiming to be able to provide decryption keys and delete stolen data for a fee. [...]
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Hong Kong Banks Turn to Student Housing as Property Bright Spot
top_signals.summary: The aging Regal Oriental Hotel is hardly a Hong Kong hotspot, yet in recent weeks it’s become a popular destination for bankers from some of the city’s top lenders, some of whom made repeat visits.
